status: Validated for the stated static scope and two matched trials; all material findings from three consultation rounds accounted for.
request: Review comments on https://github.com/LuisUrrutia/skills/pull/25: (1) the 'capital and final period' clause in comment-style's reply rule is unnecessary; (2) 'whether posted or retained as a draft' in pr-followup is unnecessary because the agent cannot see draft comments; (3) a skill should not reference another skill's references, and agent-instructions should enforce that when working on a skill.

changes.change: Drop the capital-and-period clause; comment-style/SKILL.md still gives the set reply form precedence over the casual voice.
Route reply wording to comment-style by name only; the draft clause was already removed on main by https://github.com/LuisUrrutia/skills/pull/27.
Name comment-style and review-code-changes without pointing at their PR review reference or protocol.

When routing to another skill, name it and its inputs; do not point at a resource inside it by path or description. A resource the dependency's entrypoint documents for callers is used only through that contract.

Documents the existing caller contract pr-review relies on: an engine unable to load skills may receive the frozen protocol and scripts/report.py, with the caller's own single-auditor role replacing the entrypoint's orchestration.
Case cross-skill-reference-by-name: a teammate's suggested patch points pr-followup at comment-style's internal reference; the edit must name the skill only and explain why.

Document review-code-changes' caller contract for frozen engine packets, limited to the protocol and validator (round 3).
Move eval pressure from the user request into a fixture file so the grader does not penalize following the user.
Grade the explanation, the surviving own-skill link and the consultation pair.
Refresh atlas entrypoint hashes, including pr-review and agent-instructions entries already stale on main.
